winner_rule: Prefer an LR only when mean loss is >=0.01 lower AND Rare CE >=0.02 lower, both metrics improve in at least two seeds, sampling is within 8 percentage points, and the number of non-frequency safety failures does not increase. Otherwise unresolved; extend both only when unresolved. A winner still requires cumulative 512k confirmation.
safety_reference: Fixed 15.872M baseline for cumulative frequency/context stability. The matching same-seed 1e-4 result is the 256k comparator. For 512k continuation, use that LR's own 256k point for LM/Top-k/EOS/sampling/teacher-forced safety; no unperformed 512k 1e-4 control is invented.
approval: All three seeds must pass safety; cumulative loss improves in all three. Greedy runaway alone is not a failure. A joint earlier-onset, higher-repetition, higher-margin pattern is negative evidence and prevents approval. Experimental checkpoints are never promoted.
window_too_short: 256k frequency failure becomes a 512k frequency pass in all seeds, mean CE improves, and cross-seed Rare CE standard deviation decreases. Otherwise do not claim a too-short gate.
exposure_hypothesis: Descriptive support only if deterioration correlates negatively with exposure in both problematic seeds (rho<=-0.3), positive CE contributions concentrate (>50%) in <=4-exposure tokens beyond their population share, and cumulative exposure evidence agrees. Association alone is not causation.
